cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(SomeEngineMetis LANGUAGES C)
file(GLOB METIS_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS libmetis/*.c)
file(GLOB GK_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS GKlib/*.c)
if(WIN32)
  list(APPEND GK_SOURCES GKlib/win32/adapt.c)
endif()
add_library(metis SHARED ${METIS_SOURCES} ${GK_SOURCES})
set_target_properties(metis PROPERTIES WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS ON)
target_include_directories(metis PRIVATE include libmetis GKlib)
target_compile_definitions(metis PRIVATE USE_GKREGEX)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_definitions(metis PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
  target_compile_definitions(metis PRIVATE "__thread=__declspec(thread)")
else()
  target_link_libraries(metis PRIVATE m)
endif()
